summary: Answer strict exact RFI, Submittal and Email action-field questions locally and ground the same identity, source scope, role and complete value in model-generated answers and source findings.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Explicit action fields are useful only when they remain distinct from recommendations, ordinary prose, Email headers, quoted history and signatures
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer exact labelled fields without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions requesting one supported printed action field use the local shortcut.
Workflow questions require one exact RFI or Submittal; Email questions require the only analyzed Email or one exact named .eml/.msg file.
Headers, quoted history, signatures, ordinary instructions and unlabeled prose remain outside the field contract.
More than 32 primary files or candidate passages and conflicting explicit values fail closed.
The implementation does not infer applicability, responsibility, approval, chronology, authority, action ownership or equivalence between distinct action roles.
